```{r}
tidy.glmmTMB <- function(mod, component = c("cond", "disp", "zi"), ...) {
    is_disp <- "disp" %in% component
    if (is_disp) component <- component[-which(component == "disp")]
    df <- broom.mixed:::tidy.glmmTMB(mod, component = component, ...)
    if (is_disp) {
        S <- summary(mod)
        C <- coef(S)$disp
        if (!is.null(C)) {
            C <- cbind(term = rownames(C), as.data.frame(C)) %>%
                as_tibble %>%
                set_names(c(
                    "term", "estimate",
                    "std.error", "statistic", "p.value"
                )) %>%
                mutate(
                    effect = "fixed",
                    component = "disp",
                    group = NA_character_,
                    .before = 1L,
                )
        }
        V <- S$varcor$disp
        if (!is.null(V)) {
            V <- tibble(
                effect = "ran_pars",
                component = "disp",
                group = names(V),
                term = map_chr(V, ~names(attr(.x, "stddev"))),
                estimate = map_dbl(V, attr, "stddev"),
                std.error = NA_real_,
                statistic = NA_real_,
                p.value = NA_real_,
            )
        }
        df <- bind_rows(df, C, V)
    }
    df
}
```

```{python}
def sanitize_term(term, ref=list(countries)[0]):
    def sanitize(t: str):
        if t.startswith((prefix := "country")):
            return t.removeprefix(prefix).upper()
        if t.startswith((prefix := "political")):
            return t.removeprefix(prefix).lower()
        if t.startswith((prefix := "valence")):
            return t.removeprefix(prefix).lower()
        if t == "(Intercept)":
            return f"(Intercept = {ref.upper()})"
        return t
    sep = "__"
    comp, term = term.split(sep) if sep in term else (None, term)
    term = ", ".join(
        r" $\times$ ".join(map(sanitize, t.split(":")))
        for t in term.split(".")
    )
    if comp == "sd":
        term = rf"$\sigma(\text{{{term}}})$"
    elif comp == "cor":
        term = rf"$\rho(\text{{{term}}})$"
    return term


def make_modeltable(df, topkey: str | None = None):
    df = (
        df
        .drop(columns=["statistic"])
        .set_index(["effect", "component", "group", "term"])
        .rename(columns={
            "estimate":  "b",
            "std.error": "se",
            "p.value":   "p",
        })
        .rename(lambda s: "fixed" if pd.isnull(s) else s, level="group")
        .rename({
            "country:name": "country:outlet",
            "country:year:month:day": "country:day",
        }, level="group")
        .rename(sanitize_term, level="term")
    )
    if topkey is not None:
        df = pd.concat({topkey: df}, axis=1)
    return df

make_modeltable
```

```{python}
def format_num(x, digits=3):
    return "" if np.isnan(x) else f"{x:.{digits}f}"

def format_pval(p, digits=3):
    if p < 10**-digits:
        return f"{p:.{digits}e}"
    return format_num(p, digits)

mergekw = {"how": "left", "left_index": True, "right_index": True}
tab = (
    make_modeltable(r.Tr, "Reactions")
    .merge(make_modeltable(r.Tc, "Comments"), **mergekw)
    .merge(make_modeltable(r.Ts, "Shares"), **mergekw)
    .merge(make_modeltable(r.Tn, "Valence"), **mergekw)
    .droplevel(level=0)
    .loc[["cond", "disp"]]
    [["Valence", "Reactions", "Comments", "Shares"]]
    .droplevel(level=["component"])
    .rename_axis(index={"group": "effect"})
    .pipe(lambda df: df.style.format(
        escape=False,
        formatter={
            n: format_pval if n[1] == "p" else format_num
            for n in df.columns
        },
    ))
    .pipe(lambda df: print(df.to_latex(
        hrules=True,
        multicol_align="c",
        multirow_align="t",
        siunitx=False,
    )))
)
```
